prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1193; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you please state where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in Pearland, Texas, driving through an intersection on my way home from work.

Q: Were you turning, and if so, in what direction?

A: Yes, I was turning left. I had a green arrow, or at least I believed I did, and I started into the turn when the other vehicle came through.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I glanced to my right when I started the turn and I didn't see anything coming. Then there was a loud bang and my car spun a little.

Q: How fast do you estimate you were going?

A: Maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour. I was slowing down for the turn.

Q: Was anyone else in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Did you call for medical attention, or did you go to a clinic afterward?

A: The paramedics checked me out at the scene. Later I went to an urgent care clinic because my wrist was swelling badly and I couldn't move my fingers properly.

Q: What injuries were diagnosed?

A: The doctor said I have a fracture in my left wrist. I've been told I'll need a cast and possibly a follow-up with a specialist.

Q: Have you been out of work since the accident?

A: Yes, I'm not able to do my job with one hand, so I've been off since then.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was careful going into that turn, and I'm hoping this gets sorted out quickly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
